summary.text: Nathan Wesenberg is a Republican member of the Minnesota State Senate for District 10 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A wildlife biologist who was born in and lives in Little Falls, he faces Democrat Tara Killen in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Wesenberg was born in and lives in Little Falls, Minnesota, and his career experience includes working as a wildlife biologist.
Wesenberg defeated Steve Wenzel and Jim Newberger in the August 2022 Republican primary for District 10 and Suzanne Cekalla in the November 2022 general election, taking office on January 3, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture and Rural Development Finance and Policy, Education Policy, Labor and Industry Policy, and Environment and Natural Resources Policy and Legacy Finance committees.
